thread:
Maya (partnerships): FYI we're running a condensed SI fast-track for three certified integrators next month. Objective: deploy Redwood Private, publish marketplace listing, and enable a joint announcement. Quick planning thread.
Liam (solutions): Sounds good. Scope? 2-week hands-on? Labs + capstone?
Nora (enablement): Proposed: week1 = infra + security + HW kit handoff; week2 = marketplace listing + capstone + cert. Daily 2hr labs, mentor drop-ins.
Diego (field-eng): Must include HSM/KMS onboarding and a small NAT/firewall troubleshooting doc. Those are always blockers.
Ravi (training): Cert idea: "SI Fast-Deploy" micro-cert, two modules + capstone. Automated checks: control-plane heartbeat, model pin & rollback, basic 99p latency under sim load. Badge via LMS.
Maya (partnerships): Who owns kit shipping/customs? Two EU partners requested DDP.
Liam (solutions): PartnerOps covers DDP for strategic partners up to $5k; others billed. I'll confirm thresholds.
Nora (enablement): We'll create per-partner slack channels and record sessions. Also build a 20-prompt eval for semantic drift during capstone.
Ravi (training): I'll build the eval harness and hook it into the cert runner. Metrics: latency, cost-per-token, semantic accuracy.
Diego (field-eng): Repo for lab harness: github.com/redwood-inference/si-fastlabs (internal). It has traffic gen + KV cache toggles. Adding mentors now.
PartnerOpsBot: Fast-track cohort created: cohort-si-fast-2026. Enrollment: https://console.redwood.ai/partners/enroll/cohort-si-fast-2026 (internal).
Maya (partnerships): Need a marketplace checklist page: billing SKU mapping, test purchase flow, legal quote lines to include in listing.
Liam (solutions): I'll draft the listing checklist and the joint-announcement script (PR approvals, co-branding guidelines, legal signoff window).
Nora (enablement): Action items: 1) Ravi - finalize cert rubric (due 1955007200). 2) Diego - NAT/firewall runbook (due 1955005400). 3) Liam - shipping policy confirmation (due 1955004200). 4) Maya - outreach email + invite (EOD).
Ravi (training): Noted. Will also automate LMS badge push and export SCORM package.
Maya (partnerships): A hardware partner asked for a co-branded kit flyer. Liam, can design whip up a 1-pager?
Liam (solutions): Yes, will request a quick mock from Design. Partner logos only after sign-off.
Diego (field-eng): I'll draft a short "first-connection" checklist for day 0 to avoid delays.
Maya (partnerships): Great. If no objections I'll open outreach tomorrow and lock mentors. :rocket:
Liam (solutions): :thumbsup: we can cover mentor slots.
Nora (enablement): I'll schedule drop-in hours and seed channels.
Ravi (training): Will upload lab artifacts and test scripts by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks team — we'll regroup after partner signups close.
